綑綁銷售.u: A business and marketing term, common in telecoms, software, travel and meal sets. It is not a traditional idiom but a widely used four-character compound. It differs from tying, where buying one product obliges the customer to buy another, which can raise competition-law concerns; bundling stresses selling as a set and need not forbid buying items separately.
